facts.business: Supra Pacific Financial Services Limited is a retail-focused NBFC providing diversified financial services including Gold Loans, Vehicle Loans, Microfinance, Traders Loans, Personal Loans, Working Capital Loans, and insurance-related services to individuals, self-employed customers, small traders, micro-entrepreneurs, and other underserved segments.

auditor.name: M/s G Joseph & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Impairment of carrying value of loans and advances - estimation involves significant management judgement; provisioning rates benchmarked to peer lenders due to shorter operating history; management overlays not supported by detailed quantitative analysis or back-testing.

key_risks: Impairment estimation involves significant management judgement due to shorter operating history and lack of stable own historical default experience
Provisioning rates benchmarked to peer lenders rather than derived from own default history
Management overlays and assumptions in impairment provision not supported by detailed quantitative analysis or back-testing
facts.related_party_note: Contracts/arrangements/transactions with related parties during FY 2025-26 were in ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis. No material related party transactions as per Regulation 23 of SEBI LODR. Particulars in Form AOC-2 enclosed as Annexure II.
